description: A default for an optional attribute of type any keeps its own type
notes: The README allows any in function TypeConstraint only, and convert-with-defaults reads its type with TypeConstraintWithDefaults, whose documentation says it parses a type constraint, which TypeConstraint's documentation says additionally allows the keyword any. hashicorp/hcl reads both with getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go), which allows any whenever it reads a type constraint and converts the default to the dynamic pseudo-type with go-cty's convert.Convert, which keeps its type.
